details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1931-1944 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The `unblock_resolve_own_prs` GraphQL query selects `context state creator { login }` directly on `status.contexts`, which these reviewers say is a connection that needs `nodes`.
  WHY: If so, every real read returns `errors` and is classed `own_pr_unknown`, so the default-on guard refuses every issue re-issue (the tests/test_unblock_judge.py:6509 fixture uses a flat array and hides this). Severity differs: gemini and minimax say BLOCKER, luna says MAJOR, and the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this claim and rejected it: they say `Status.contexts` is a plain list `[StatusContext!]!`.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1926-2936 (with scripts/unblock_actions.py:478-501 `_own_pr_retire_ops`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The own-PR head-gate and `ai:merge-lease-wait` facts are read once before the long model call and are not read again before G3 comments "Superseded by #<new>" on the own PR and closes it (plan/`unblock_run_ops` at 2901-2908). The `close` verdict, by contrast, re-reads and fails closed at 2823-2858.
  WHY: A PR that turns green or gets the lease-wait label during the model call is still closed, and `cancel_on_pr_close.yml` releases its lease. A PR opened during that window is missed. G2/G3 forbid both outcomes.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2777-2788 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The refusal `else` branch (reached for `own_pr_unknown` and for any refusal while `UNBLOCK_JUDGE_WAIT_ENABLED=false`) posts only the refusal comment and returns 0. It writes no `ai:unblock:v1` or `ai:unblock-wait:v1` marker.
  WHY: The scan backs off only on those markers, so after `UNBLOCK_JUDGE_INFLIGHT_MINUTES` (default 60) the item is judged again. Each run makes a new model call and posts another identical "Not re-issued ..." comment, with no limit from round caps or `UNBLOCK_JUDGE_RETRY_HOURS`.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1931 (with scripts/unblock_actions.py:279, :416) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The query fetches `pullRequests(... first: 10)`, but `_own_prs` turns any list longer than `OWN_PR_MAX = 5` into `unknown`.
  WHY: With 6 or more open own PRs, every run becomes a permanent `own_pr_unknown` refusal, G3 never retires any of them, and the comment loop above repeats. Severity differs: minimax says MAJOR, gemini and glm say NIT, and the highest is used.
- scripts/stage_switches.json:817-821 (parsers scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1912-1915, scripts/unblock_actions.py:388-403) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `UNBLOCK_REISSUE_OWN_PR_GUARD_ENABLED` registry entry declares `on_values: ["1", "yes", "on"]`, but both parsers turn the guard off only for `false`.
  WHY: With `0`, `no` or `off` the guard stays on, yet the stage-switch watch reports it as off and sends a false `STAGE_SWITCH_OFF` WARNING after 24h. The sibling `MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED` parser accepts `false|0|no|off`.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4511-4556 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The update-mode lease grant calls `_merge_lease_queue_first` without an exclude list, so an orphan `ai/issue-<n>` PR (issue closed as not planned) can still take a free lease through its own run's gate.
  WHY: The G4 exclusion exists only in `_mt_merge_lease_tick` and `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi`. Orphans have low PR numbers and win `_merge_lease_order_key`, so they take `held` and other callers get `queued_behind` with `MERGE_LEASE_BLOCKER=<orphan>`.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2763-2766 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When the `own-pr-refusal` output is not JSON or fails the shape check, the `own_pr_check_failed` skip logs and returns 0 without writing a marker.
  WHY: This is the same retry-window bug as the refusal `else` branch: the item is picked up again every `UNBLOCK_JUDGE_INFLIGHT_MINUTES`, and round caps and retry hours never apply.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:1432-1434 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: G3 retire ops are added only when the plan closes the source issue, so they do not fire on the tracked security re-issue path.
  WHY: The reviewer concludes there is no runtime defect: non-security tracked re-issues do close the source issue and retire the PR, and the security path matches the security policy.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G2: "The planned operations are one comment on the issue naming the pull request and why nothing was re-issued, and the verdict is recorded as a wait." "unknown (G1 read failed) also refuses."
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, own-PR refusal `else` branch (lines 2768-2788)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: For `own_pr_unknown` and for any refusal while `unblock_wait_enabled` is false, the branch at lines 2777-2787 posts only the comment and returns, with no `ai:unblock-wait:v1` marker, no round marker and no wait verdict. The retry window and round caps never apply. Tests test_failed_own_pr_read_refuses_and_creates_nothing and test_green_own_pr_with_waits_disabled_posts_only_the_refusal confirm that only a comment is written.
- requirement: Approach step 1: "gather the own-PR facts ... and pass them in the context JSON; add them to the judge prompt's evidence block."
  expected_change_site: prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt line 11 (and prompts/_templates/mode-judge-unblock.txt)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `own_pull_requests` is added to judge_context.json (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:3062-3064), but no hunk touches prompts/. No prompt text explains `head_gate`, `ci_final` or `lease_wait`. Reviewers note that prompts/ is outside the files_touched grant and that the code still enforces the refusal.
- requirement: G3: "When a `reissue` goes ahead and the issue has an open own pull request that is not green, the operations also comment on that pull request ('Superseded by #<new>') and close it."
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_actions.py, tracked security re-issue path (lines 1408-1425) and the retire-op gate at lines 1432-1434 / `_own_pr_retire_ops`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Retire ops are added only when the plan closes the source issue. The tracked security re-issue path never closes the source issue, so a non-green own PR on that path is never commented on or closed. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 considered this deliberate and did not report it.
- requirement: G4: "The merge-lease grant skips a pull request whose head ref is `ai/issue-<n>` when issue `<n>` is closed with state reason `not_planned`."
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh, update-mode lease acquisition (around lines 4511-4556)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The exclusion is added only to the two tick functions in scripts/review_merge_train.sh. The agents.d fragment says "the update-mode gate does not use it".
- requirement: G1: "The judge sees the issue's own pull request. ... A failed read is recorded as `unknown`, never as 'none'."
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1926-1969 (`unblock_resolve_own_prs`) and scripts/unblock_actions.py:406-440 (`_own_prs`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The query at scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1931 selects leaf fields directly on `status.contexts`, which the reviewer says is a connection, so every production read would be `unknown`. The fixture at tests/test_unblock_judge.py:6509 returns a flat array. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute this.
- requirement: "The context handed to the judge and to `unblock_actions.py` lists the open pull requests" and includes their required facts.
  expected_change_site: `scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_resolve_own_prs` and `scripts/unblock_actions.py:_own_prs`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The query fetches at most 10 PRs, but `_own_prs` rejects any list longer than 5 as `unknown`, so 6 or more matching PRs are never listed.
- requirement: G4: "One batched read per base (50 issues per query, none without such a waiter); a failed read logs `outcome=unavailable reason=source_issue_read_failed` and grants as before."
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2944-3010 (`_merge_lease_source_issue_orphans`) and scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2248-2266 + 2608-2624
  confidence=1
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The reviewer states there is no gap: the early return is at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2995-2998, and the unavailable log is at scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2255-2256, 2616-2617.
- requirement: G5: "New switch `UNBLOCK_REISSUE_OWN_PR_GUARD_ENABLED`, default `true` ... G4 gets `MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED`, default `true`."
  expected_change_site: README.md variable table, scripts/stage_switches.json, workflow env exports, parsers in scripts/unblock_actions.py, scripts/unblock_judge.sh, scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh
  confidence=1
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The reviewer states both switches are delivered (stage_switches.json lines 402-407 and 817-821, README lines 129 and 171, workflow exports). The only mismatch is the parser/registry off-value set.
- requirement: §14: "G1 adds one pulls read per judged issue (head filter), plus one statuses read per own pull request"
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1931-1932
  confidence=1
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The reviewer states there is no gap: a single GraphQL read returns head, status and merge state, with no status read per PR.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh (with scripts/unblock_actions.py `_own_pr_retire_ops`):2659, 2901-2902, 2908 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The G3 close of the own PR uses head-gate/lease-wait facts captured before the model call and never read again. The `close` verdict re-reads fresh (#6557, lines 2823-2858), but re-issue does not.
  WHY: A PR that turns green or lease-waiting during the window is still closed and its lease released, and a PR opened in the window stays open as a duplicate. Fix: re-run `unblock_resolve_own_prs` and `own-pr-refusal` before line 2901 and skip with `own_pr_changed`.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4511-4556 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The update-mode gate passes no exclude list to `_merge_lease_queue_first`, so an orphan can still acquire a free lease.
  WHY: Orphans win `_merge_lease_order_key` (#9562 after #9519 closed). Other callers get `queued_behind` with `MERGE_LEASE_BLOCKER=<orphan>`. Fix: call `_merge_lease_source_issue_orphans` in update mode and return `wait` with reason `source_issue_not_planned`.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2777-2787 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The refusal `else` branch writes no `ai:unblock:v1`/`ai:unblock-wait:v1` marker (scan backs off only on scripts/unblock_scan.py:173 `MARKER_PREFIXES`), so a persistent refusal has no back-off.
  WHY: Af
